scenario: An all-Int division by zero raises a ComputationError on the stream, not a TypeError and not an EngineError. The operands are Int because only an all-Int division traps ([LEXP.7.15.1]); with a Float operand the division is IEEE's and answers ±Inf (LEXP.7.15.float). The divisor is a RUNTIME zero read from a slot, because a literal zero divisor is refused at compile time ([LEXP.10.2.2]) — so the trap is raised inside the beta join test, which is `ds_rete_fault(ctx, expr, DS_FAULT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO)` from the Int arm of `DS_RETE_BINOP_DIV` in rete/eval.c, and NOT the action path. The rule must not fire: [LERR.1] rung 6 abandons the activation and leaves the engine intact.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    a: Int mutable
    b: Int mutable

rule div:
    S s where s.a / s.b > 1.0
->
    log info "fired"
